propositions: The session-scoped run_request_sites fixture rebuilds full parent maps and re-walks every cached source tree for each lookup, causing 9.6M AST node iterations and 130.9M calls to produce the same 24 ordered tuples.
_enclosing and _verdict in test_subcall_class_selection.py perform repeated whole-tree traversals to rediscover parent and caller relationships despite having cached parsed AST trees.
Parent and caller indexing must be computed once per pytest process from already-cached parsed trees, with _verdict and related helpers querying immutable indices instead of re-walking.
The exact current 24 provenance tuples, guard verdicts, and semantic behavior must remain unchanged after indexing optimization.
A deterministic oracle must fail when per-lookup parent-map rebuilding is reintroduced and pass when indices are built once per process.
Cold-process setup time must improve from 49.96s/53.03s/53.58s while preserving all 486 modules traversed exactly three times (discovery, site discovery, shared index).
